headlines.title: Man arrested in connection with his mom's death in Pleasant Hill
headlines.description: A man was arrested in connection with his mom’s homicide in Pleasant Hill, the police department said on Saturday. Authorities said a friend of a resident called the police to request a welfare check after being unable to reach her for several days. Officers responded to the home in the 1100 block of Black Pine Lane around 3:36 p.m. There, officers found 84-year-old Katherine Guilford dead inside the home, according to officials. Police said the incident is being investigated as a homicide based on the circumstances surrounding her death. Police said 55-year-old David Guilford, the victim’s son, was arrested in connection with the investigation. Authorities said this is an ongoing investigation and asked anyone with information to contact them at 925-288-4600.
